name: Document 28
definition: General information that unambiguously identifies a document, such as identification number and issue date time.

TechnicalRecordIdentifier.name: Technical Record Identifier
TechnicalRecordIdentifier.definition: Unique identifier of a document or data record in a message used as part of error management and status advice messages.||Usage:|This identification will be used in the status advice report sent back.

Version.name: Version
Version.definition: Specifies the version number of the document or data record submitted.

SubmissionType.name: Submission Type
SubmissionType.definition: Indication as to whether the report is new or a previous report is amended or cancelled.

RelatedEntity.name: Related Entity
RelatedEntity.definition: Entity to which the information relates.

RegulatoryDataType.name: Regulatory Data Type
RegulatoryDataType.definition: Type of information in accordance with a taxonomy relevant for a legal act.

Voluntary.name: Voluntary
Voluntary.definition: Indication as to whether the information is submitted on a voluntary basis.||Usage: True if the information is submitted on a voluntary basis. If the element is not present, the Voluntary flag is False.

HistoricalData.name: Historical Data
HistoricalData.definition: Information whether the regulatory data is historical data.||Usage: True if the regulatory data is historical data. If the element is not present, the historical data flag is 'false'.

RelatedPeriod.name: Related Period
RelatedPeriod.definition: Period to which the information relates.

PersonalData.name: Personal Data
PersonalData.definition: Indication whether the information contains personal data.||Usage: True if the information contains personal data. If the element is not present, the personal data flag is 'false'.

PublicationPeriod.name: Publication Period
PublicationPeriod.definition: Period during which the regulatory data should be published.

SubmissionDateTime.name: Submission Date Time
SubmissionDateTime.definition: Date and time when the regulatory data was submitted by the submitting entity to the collection body.

HomeCountry.name: Home Country
HomeCountry.definition: Home member state as defined in the legal framework for the type of information.

HostCountry.name: Host Country
HostCountry.definition: Host member state as defined in the legal framework for the type of information.

RelatedProductIdentifier.name: Related Product Identifier
RelatedProductIdentifier.definition: ISIN or other product identifier to which the regulatory data relates.

DocumentReference.name: Document Reference
DocumentReference.definition: Reference to the document containing the regulatory data.

DataRecord.name: Data Record
DataRecord.definition: Regulatory data when included inside the message.
